mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment ( mail_id, uploader_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, upload_time ) VALUES ( #{mailId}, #{uploaderId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id, file_name, file_size, file_type, CONCAT('/api/attachment/download/', attachment_id) AS download_url FROM attachment WHERE mail_id = #{mailId} ORDER BY upload_time ASC, attachment_id ASC
